reason: We already have an ERP with a notice board and SMS alerts, and if students need a better feed I will ask our vendor to add it rather than bring in another small company. There is no budget left this academic year anyway, and nine lakh a year for notifications will not get through committee.
objection: This is one more vendor touching student data and our Microsoft 365, for something our ERP vendor should be giving us. If the Hyderabad startup shuts down in two years, I am the one answering for it.
would_change_my_mind: If our existing ERP vendor partnered with them or offered it as an add-on, and the pilot report showed a clear drop in missed exams that I could put in front of the committee before next year's budget is set.
